items.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued October 31 at 6:40AM AKDT until October 31 at 4:00PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Light freezing rain and snow expected. Total snow
accumulations up to three inches with a glaze of ice.

* WHERE...Central Arctic Plains, and Beaufort Sea Coast.

* WHEN...Until 4 PM AKDT this afternoon.

* IMPACTS...Travel may be difficult.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Chances of light freezing rain return across
an area including the Dalton Highway north of the Brooks Range and
the Arctic Coast from Deadhorse and Nuiqsut east early Saturday
morning through the afternoon.
items.areas: Central Beaufort Sea Coast; Eastern Beaufort Sea Coast; Central Arctic Plains
items.instruction:
Be prepared for slippery roads. Slow down and use caution while
driving. If you are going outside, watch your first few steps taken
on stairs, sidewalks, and driveways. These surfaces could be icy and
slippery, increasing your risk of a fall and injury.

items.headline: Wind Advisory issued October 31 at 6:26AM AKDT until October 31 at 1:00PM AKDT by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Southeast winds 20 to 30 mph with gusts up to 45 mph.

* WHERE...City and Borough of Yakutat.

* WHEN...Until 1 PM AKDT this afternoon.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.
items.instruction:
Winds this strong can make travel difficult. Use extra caution.

Secure outdoor objects.

items.headline: Special Weather Statement issued October 31 at 5:22AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Snow expected. Total snow accumulations between 3 and 6
inches. Winds gusting 20 to 25 mph along the coast will
gradually decrease through the weekend.

* WHERE...Noatak Valley and Northwest Arctic Coast including
Kivalina.

* WHEN...Through Sunday afternoon. Heaviest snow expected through
Saturday morning.

* IMPACTS...Travel could be difficult. Areas of blowing snow
could reduce visibility.
items.areas: Noatak Valley; Kivalina and Red Dog Dock

items.headline: Winter Storm Warning issued October 31 at 2:32AM AKDT until November 1 at 9:00AM AKST by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Heavy snow expected. Total snow accumulations of 9 to 14
inches possible. Winds gusting as high as 40 mph. Blowing snow
possible.

* WHERE...The Klondike Highway including White Pass

* WHEN...From 10 AM AKDT this morning to 9 AM AKST Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Travel could be very difficult to impossible. Conditions
will likely become slick and hazardous.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Snow levels will start out around 600' early
Saturday morning but are expected to rise to around 1,500' by mid
day
items.instruction:
If you must travel, keep an extra flashlight, food, and water in your
vehicle in case of an emergency. For the latest road conditions where
available call 511 or visit 511.alaska.gov.
